title: Thomas Olney
wikitext:
[[Image:ThomasOlney.png|thumb]]
'''Thomas Olney''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[The Rope and Anchor]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Luck]]
*+1 [[Sneak]]

You are [[Bless]]ed when Thomas Olney joins you.

==Mythos Source==
Olney appears in the story ''The Strange High House in the Mist'' (1926), written by H.P. Lovecraft, as a philosopher who visits the [[Strange High House|strange house]] while on a visit to [[Kingsport]].
